mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Over at Reddan Soccer Park, we have overcast skies with a temperature of 62 degrees. For tonight, we are looking at an overnight low of 61 degrees with rain predicted, all under a waxing crescent moon.

The Verona Police Department published their weekly recap detailing several significant incidents between August 31st and September 14th, including a burglary on Hunters Cove Way and an O W I crash on Shooting Star Road.

Tomorrow brings several trivia options, including Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia, and Dream Day Trivia. On September 16th, you can enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and live music at Paddy Mac's.

Last Thursday night, officers responded to a burglary in progress on Hunters Cove Way where a gunshot was heard and an officer successfully detained a suspect who was bleeding profusely from a window injury.
Culver's is closed for the day and will remain closed tomorrow for a remodel, so there is no featured flavor of the day.
